governance_lessons: §2 claim protocol (coordination_guard.py): ONE OPEN PR PER TASK ID, computed from branch 't-<task>/run-N' and/or title '^T-<task>' / '(T-<task>)'. Opening three PRs at once failed coordination on every head (this PR-set double-claimed qa-org-001). Sequential re-runs pass cleanly — the guard's own stated resolution.
Title-only attribution quirk: a title 'T-QA-ORG-001 + T-QA-GAPS-001: ...' claims ONLY the FIRST id (prefix regex stops at the space) — the second id is invisible to the guard.

Stale-run diagnosis: a queued coordination run from PR creation executed late and failed against a world that no longer existed (it saw a PR as open that was already merged). The check-runs list carries BOTH runs; merge gating uses the NEWEST run per required check — poll by newest, not by presence of any failure.

Branch naming: these lanes used 't-qa-<id>/{fix,qa}' — the §2 rule-2 shape 't-<task>/run-N' was not met, so attribution ran on titles alone (works, but unattributed if a title lacks the id). This landing run uses the proper shape: t-qa-org-001/run-004.
